initial.markdown:
# Synthetic AP authentication timeout case

## Error Pattern

Lab clients report AUTH_TIMEOUT after association begins. [SRC-0001:L1-L3]

## Log Analysis

The runtime sequence records authentication failure after the 4-way handshake starts. [SRC-0001:L2-L4]

## Root Cause

The configuration comparison verifies a shared-key mismatch; the fixture explicitly does not establish a firmware defect. [SRC-0002:L1-L3]

## Solution

Back up the configuration, apply the approved matching shared key, and restart only the WLAN authentication service. [SRC-0003:L1-L4]

## Validation

Authentication succeeds and the observation window has no new AUTH_TIMEOUT event. [SRC-0004:L1-L3]

## Scope and Limitations

This conclusion applies only to the synthetic GOLDEN-AP-01 fixture. Other devices require independent evidence.

- Symptom report: [SRC-0001:L1-L4]
- Root-cause analysis: [SRC-0002:L1-L3]
- Recovery procedure: [SRC-0003:L1-L4]
- Validation record: [SRC-0004:L1-L3]
